key_catalyst: Oil prices rise amid renewed Middle East tensions, extending the unresolved Iran/MACRO_SHOCK narrative into overnight risk
reasoning: The session declined -0.83% as oil prices rose on renewed Middle East tensions and a 'Why SK hynix Will Drag Down Markets, Again' article added semiconductor competitive-pressure concerns. Both dominant themes — MACRO_SHOCK (Iran/oil) and SECTOR_ROTATION (semis) — show DOWN-dominant memory responses (2 DOWN vs 1 UP and 1 UP vs 2 DOWN respectively) and neither catalyst is resolving: oil is rising not falling, and the SK hynix $26.5B debut intensifies the capital-drain and competitive-pressure narrative that has been pressuring chip stocks. With no positive counter-catalyst emerging intraday to stabilize sentiment, overnight gap-down risk is material as Asian trading could extend oil's rise and react to the SK hynix competitive pressure.
